description: Molar mass + percent composition calculator — Offline chemistry calculator: parse a molecular formula (brackets like Ca3(PO4)2 or K4[Fe(CN)6], hydrates like CuSO4.5H2O) and return molar mass in g/mol, Hill formula, atom count and per-element mass contribution and mass percent, using IUPAC standard atomic weights. Optional grams= converts to moles and molecules, or moles= converts to grams. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_molar_mass
